units.english: Successfully boarded an Aberrant. A strange presence seemed to watch during the investigation, one that gave a sense of foreboding. It appears to be a single, ship-sized organism that can travel in space using a special exoskeleton.
units.italian: Sei riuscito ad abbordare un Aberrant. Durante l'ispezione sembrava esserci una strana presenza a osservare, che dava un senso di inquietudine. Pare essere un unico organismo grande quanto una nave, capace di viaggiare nello spazio usando uno speciale esoscheletro.

units.id: mission:Disabled Aberrant|You draw the <flagship> alongside this strange entity, which, despite its lack of motion, seems to exude an ominous presence. Something feels fundamentally wrong with this ship as you approach a hole in a vulnerable part of its hull, which seems to be some kind of shell encasing a large, slug-like creature. Exposed to weapons fire, the creature seems to be dead, but you feel almost as if something is watching you.|27|0
units.english: You draw the <flagship> alongside this strange entity, which, despite its lack of motion, seems to exude an ominous presence. Something feels fundamentally wrong with this ship as you approach a hole in a vulnerable part of its hull, which seems to be some kind of shell encasing a large, slug-like creature. Exposed to weapons fire, the creature seems to be dead, but you feel almost as if something is watching you.
units.italian: Accosti la <flagship> a questa strana entità che, nonostante l'immobilità, sembra emanare una presenza sinistra. C'è qualcosa di profondamente sbagliato in questa nave mentre ti avvicini a un foro in una parte vulnerabile dello scafo, che sembra una sorta di guscio attorno a una grande creatura simile a una lumaca. Colpita dal fuoco delle armi, la creatura sembra morta, ma ti sembra quasi che qualcosa ti stia osservando.

units.id: mission:Disabled Aberrant|	You have no trouble docking with what seems to be its "exoskeleton," trying to decide what to do next. While the Aberrant is too different from a normal ship for you to command it, it's safe to say that you can now loot some of its outfits. The rest appear to be embedded in some kind of hard, glassy tissue; perhaps destroying the ship could release them.|28|0
units.english: You have no trouble docking with what seems to be its "exoskeleton," trying to decide what to do next. While the Aberrant is too different from a normal ship for you to command it, it's safe to say that you can now loot some of its outfits. The rest appear to be embedded in some kind of hard, glassy tissue; perhaps destroying the ship could release them.
units.italian: Non hai problemi ad attraccare a quello che sembra il suo "esoscheletro", cercando di decidere che cosa fare. Benché l'Aberrant sia troppo diverso da una nave normale perché tu possa comandarlo, è lecito dire che ora puoi saccheggiare alcuni dei suoi equipaggiamenti. Gli altri sembrano incastonati in una sorta di tessuto duro e vitreo; forse distruggere la nave potrebbe liberarli.

units.english: Successfully boarded an Aberrant. It appears to strongly resemble a Ka'het, yet one that has been twisted into a new form, one that feels fundamentally wrong.
units.italian: Sei riuscito ad abbordare un Aberrant. Sembra somigliare molto a un Ka'het, ma piegato in una forma nuova, che dà una sensazione di profondo sbaglio.

units.id: mission:Disabled Aberrant|You draw the <flagship> alongside this strange, yet almost-familiar entity, which, despite its lack of motion, seems to exude an ominous presence. Something feels fundamentally wrong with this ship, which superficially resembles a Ka'het, yet is clearly not one - perhaps a distant relation, or a Ka'het that has been irrevocably changed by something else. You approach a hole in a vulnerable part of its hull, where a 'het slug appears dead, but you feel almost as if it still watches you.|33|0
units.english: You draw the <flagship> alongside this strange, yet almost-familiar entity, which, despite its lack of motion, seems to exude an ominous presence. Something feels fundamentally wrong with this ship, which superficially resembles a Ka'het, yet is clearly not one - perhaps a distant relation, or a Ka'het that has been irrevocably changed by something else. You approach a hole in a vulnerable part of its hull, where a 'het slug appears dead, but you feel almost as if it still watches you.
units.italian: Accosti la <flagship> a questa strana entità, eppure quasi familiare, che nonostante l'immobilità sembra emanare una presenza sinistra. C'è qualcosa di profondamente sbagliato in questa nave, che superficialmente somiglia a un Ka'het ma chiaramente non lo è: forse un parente lontano, o un Ka'het cambiato irrimediabilmente da qualcos'altro. Ti avvicini a un foro in una parte vulnerabile dello scafo, dove una 'het slug sembra morta, ma ti sembra quasi che ti osservi ancora.
